The '''1961–62 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]] by three points over nearest rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]].<ref>[https://dundeefc.co.uk/club/history/our-triumphs/196162-scottish-league-champions/ 1961/62 – Scottish league champions], Dundee FC</ref> It is the only Scottish League title win in Dundee's history. [[St Johnstone F.C.|St Johnstone]] and [[Stirling Albion F.C.|Stirling Albion]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1962–63 Scottish Division Two|1962-63 Second Division]]. St Johnstone were relegated on [[goal average]], with the teams in 15th, 16th and 17th all finishing on 25 points.
